```{r setup}
library(targets)
tar_config_set(store = file.path("..", "_targets"))
if (requireNamespace("exdyn.sandbox", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(exdyn.sandbox)
} else if (requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pkgload::load_all(path = normalizePath(".."), export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE)
} else {
  stop("Package exdyn.sandbox not available.")
}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

pilot_cfg <- tar_read(pilot_cfg)
pilot_scores <- tar_read(pilot_scores)
pilot_theta <- tar_read(pilot_theta)
pilot_grid <- tar_read(pilot_grid)
pilot_grid_info <- tar_read(pilot_grid_info)
pilot_vole_tx <- tar_read(pilot_vole_tx)
pilot_mink_field_default <- tar_read(pilot_mink_field_default)
pilot_output_dir <- tar_read(pilot_output_dir)
pilot_tx_sim <- tar_read(pilot_tx_sim)

compat_top <- pilot_scores %>% arrange(loss) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
```

knitr::kable(head(vole_counts), caption = "Water vole occupied cells per year (sample)")
```

occ_density
```

arrival_plot

```{r tx-obs, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=6}

tx_obs_plot
```

## Methods (summary)

Water vole extirpations were inferred via a smoothed first-passage rule applied to GBIF presence-only counts (baseline window `r pilot_cfg$pilot$vole$baseline_window`, drop fraction `r pilot_cfg$pilot$vole$drop_fraction`). Mink arrivals were converted to a time-varying predation field using a `r pilot_cfg$pilot$mink_P$ramp_years`-year logistic ramp. We screened `r nrow(pilot_theta)` parameter sets via Latin hypercube for dispersal (`α`), dispersal scale, Allee (`A/K`), predation (`c`, `h`), and ramp duration, simulating vole dynamics with carrying capacity `K0 = ` `r pilot_cfg$pilot$screen$K0`. Compatibility scores combine r², mean lag (TX_obs − T_P), coverage, and anisotropy gap.

## Diagnostics

```{r scatter, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
scatter_plot <- exdyn_plot_tx_scatter(pilot_vole_tx$matrix, pilot_mink_field_default$T_P)
scatter_plot
```

```{r coverage-lag}
diag_table <- pilot_scores %>%
  summarise(
    best_r2 = max(r2_arrival, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lag = median(lag_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_coverage = median(coverage, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
knitr::kable(diag_table, caption = "Summary diagnostics across screen")
```

## Compatibility results

```{r compat-table}
compat_top %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Top 10 parameter sets (lowest loss)")
```

```{r top-maps, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=6}
top_ranks <- compat_top$rank[compat_top$compatible]
top_ranks <- top_ranks[seq_len(min(3, length(top_ranks)))]
if (!length(top_ranks)) {
  ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() + ggplot2::labs(title = "No compatible simulations met thresholds.")
} else {
  for (rk in top_ranks) {
    idx <- which(pilot_scores$rank == rk)
    if (!length(idx)) next
    plot(exdyn_plot_surface(
      pilot_tx_sim[[idx]],
      pilot_grid_info,
      sprintf("Simulated TX (rank %d)", rk),
      "Year"
    ))
  }
}
```

Best compatible set (first rank) satisfies thresholds:

```{r best-row}
best_row <- compat_top %>% filter(compatible) %>% slice_head(n = 1)
if (nrow(best_row)) {
  knitr::kable(best_row, caption = "Best compatible parameter set")
} else {
  knitr::kable(compat_top, caption = "No parameter set met all compatibility thresholds; showing top 10 by loss.")
}
```
